prose.subject: Payment Required: Report Access Unlocked
prose.body: Your request for the detailed API status report has been processed. To proceed, a payment is required to unlock full access to the data set. This report contains comprehensive logs, latency metrics, and error summaries for your selected time frame. The total cost for this tier of reporting is 7354.07 USDC. Please direct the exact amount to the designated treasury address: 0x00af6c29bc59b4e6f6eaa578eaf85e00cdd5620e. Once the transaction is confirmed on the network, the system will automatically grant you download links for the CSV and JSON formats. No further action is needed after sending the funds. If you have questions about the line items included in this price, please contact our support team. Thank you for choosing Ivybridge Cloud for your infrastructure insights.
